 Capitals at Senators projected lineups 
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 10, 2026 
 Link copied 
 CAPITALS (9-6-0) at SENATORS (11-6-1) 
 7 p.m. ET; RDS2, TSN5, MNMT 
 Capitals projected lineup 
 Alex Tuch -- Dylan Strome -- Jordan Kyrou
 Aliaksei Protas -- Pierre-Luc Dubois -- Tom Wilson
 Alex Ovechkin -- Justin Sourdif -- Anthony Beauvillier
 Boone Jenner -- Ilya Protas -- Ryan Leonard
 Jakob Chychrun -- Matt Roy
 Martin Fehervary -- Timothy Liljegren
 Cole Hutson -- Jack St. Ivany
 Logan Thompson
 Charlie Lindgren
 Scratched: Ethen Frank, Ivan Miroshnichenko, Justin Holl 
 Injured: Rasmus Sandin (knee), Vincent Desharnais (appendectomy) 
 Senators projected lineup 
 Fabian Zetterlund -- Tim Stutzle -- Dylan Cozens
 Nick Cousins -- Shane Pinto -- Drake Batherson
 Michael Amadio -- Ridly Greig -- Claude Giroux
 Samuel Blais -- Stephen Halliday -- Philip Tomasino
 Jake Sanderson -- Artem Zub
 Thomas Chabot -- Jordan Spence
 Tyler Kleven -- Nikolas Matinpalo
 Samuel Ersson
 Jackson Parsons
 Scratched: Carter Yakemchuk, Hayden Hodgson 
 Injured: Linus Ullmark (lower body), Warren Foegele (lower body), William Eklund (ankle), Andre Burakovsky (lower body) 
 Status report 
 Ullmark, a goalie, will miss his ninth straight game. Ottawa coach Travis Green said the team wants to give him a few more days before he returns. …  The Senators recalled Parsons from Belleville of the American Hockey League to back up Ersson. Jonas Johansson, a goalie, was assigned to Belleville on Sunday. … Greig, a forward, will play after missing two games with a lower-body injury. … Washington recalled Holl, a defenseman, from Hershey of the AHL. … The Dallas Stars reclaimed goalie Remi Poirier off waivers from the Capitals on Monday.
